newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bilfinger sees 97 results at year-ago levels.
newsitem.headline: Bilfinger sees 97 results at year-ago levels.

text.p: German construction group Bilfinger + Berger said on Wednesday that it expects its 1997 results to be around levels seen in 1996.
The group declined to detail its 1996 profits, saying only that they were satisfactory even though they had not reached year-ago levels.
Bilfinger said it expects foreign activities to buoy business as domestic construction output is expected to decline.
Bilfinger said its 1996 construction output had jumped eight percent to 9.2 billion marks ($5.5 billion) with orders in hand rising seven percent to 9.98 billion marks.
